description: For two well-orders, comparison of their types by ≤ is equivalent to existence of an initial-segment embedding.
signature:
Ordinal.type_le_iff.{u_1} {α β : Type u_1} {r : α → α → Prop} {s : β → β → Prop} [IsWellOrder α r] [IsWellOrder β s] :
  Ordinal.type r ≤ Ordinal.type s ↔ Nonempty (InitialSeg r s)
